answer: Sybil resistance works like a prism: one fake identity entering a vouching network splits into visible cost at every hop. An island economy admits newcomers only when three bonded members stake 500 tokens each on their honesty. If the newcomer cheats, every voucher's stake burns, so nectar rewards flow only to agents whose guarantees survived audits. A fraudster needs 1,500 at risk per identity, making million-bot farms a 1.5 billion loss before earning a single reward.
